scope: Production container deployment, resource planning, routing, health checks and availability design.

claims.claim: vLLM publishes official Docker images for running the OpenAI-compatible server; the Docker guide documents shared-memory configuration using either --ipc=host or --shm-size.
claims.locator: Pre-built images and shared memory notes
claims.notes: Image tags, platforms and dependencies vary across releases; pin a tested version and preferably a digest.

claims.claim: The official CUDA vLLM image runs as root by default for backward compatibility and is also prepared to run as the built-in vllm user, subject to writable cache-volume permissions.
claims.notes: Non-root support and paths should be checked against the selected image variant.

claims.claim: Production Stack prefix-aware routing sends requests with matching prompt prefixes to the same instance to improve local KV Cache reuse; load-aware routing can trade cache-hit benefit against live endpoint load.
claims.notes: Routing policy is workload-dependent; no universal cache-hit percentage is claimed.

claims.claim: Kubernetes startup probes gate liveness and readiness probes until startup succeeds; readiness controls whether traffic is sent to a Pod; liveness can trigger restart on repeated failure.
claims.locator: Probe types and when to use each probe
claims.notes: Probe endpoints, thresholds and startup budgets must be validated for the model and deployment.

claims.claim: The chapter's GPU memory budget separates weights, KV Cache, runtime workspace and safety margin as an engineering accounting model.
claims.locator: KV cache and memory configuration concepts
claims.notes: This is not an exact allocator equation or a universal memory split; measure on the target model, hardware and workload.

claims.claim: A failed replica can interrupt in-flight generation; retrying a generation request may repeat inference work unless the application adds idempotency and request-state handling.
claims.notes: POST is not defined as an idempotent method by default; retry behavior should be made safe by application-level request IDs and idempotency handling where required.
